operators.D1: Exact canonical enumeration of existing legal native bank. Select competitor by primary ON clipped contrast in first 8 samples, independently last 8; evaluate each on untouched other 8. Distinct basin >=5 of 16 bins differing >2, both fits agree within 2 throughout, cross-fit improvements on both holdouts.
operators.D2: Same candidate positive OFF contrast in both blocks and OFF exceeds primary ON in both; candidate alone shared detection cannot veto.
operators.D3: Native stationary candidate only for repeat mapping; compare exact measured bin and neighbor sidebands ±3,4,5 on both independent blocks and wide ±8..12. Require legal unmixed native bins, no padding, no edge filling. Fine vs coarse diagnostic; neither alone vetoes.
operators.D4: Maintain candidate, common receiver-frequency contaminant, competing independent coherent trajectory and unconfirmed hypotheses. Conjunction is single prespecified veto; not a fitted classifier. Local micro-pass opens only where D1/D2/D3 conjunction holds; disputed cases retained.
operators.D5: Verify 4 distinct raw file URIs, ordered nonoverlapping time intervals, same signed df, cadence roles on/off, matching source slice hashes, legal native mapped bin within 0.001 channel, 16 measured rows and 40-bin halo; independently replay primary and repeat off and repeat on. No missing data counts as evidence.

decision: Veto only when D1 competitor predicts both disjoint held-out intervals, D2 primary OFF candidate contrasts >= floor and primary ON <= ceiling with OFF-ON gap >= margin in BOTH blocks, D3 narrow OFF witness on exact native path and wide-side contrast, D5 second independent OFF scan corroborates same stationary receiver-native frequency with BOTH blocks above floor and repeat ON <= ceiling, independent second ON alternative stationary competing frequency with both blocks >= alternative floor and stronger than candidate by margin; second OFF alternative is not required absent. Both half-fitted competitors must be stationary and agree exactly in frequency for cross-scan replay. Rescue margins stricter; if any missing or disagreement retain. Meaning is experimental common-frequency contamination veto, not proof of terrestrial origin. No retraining or threshold adjustment based on outcome.
state: Content addressed evidence, not turn/time. 5 first-pass operations (one per axis); if strong conflict and data qualified, 5 second-pass operations on disjoint repeat data. Stop when no new evidence or gate resolved; zero state delta HOLD; never reset. C0 uses same operator and preserves all A alerts; C applies strict veto. Stress test uses separate synthetic repeat perturbation, evaluator only uses truth/labels for perturbation and accounting, no routing or threshold input.
comparison: A and C independent fresh native acquisition in separate CPU processes, counterbalanced order; C0 counterfactual identical to A, C0/C share measured operator (do not count as independent physical executions). Stress work excluded from normal inference timing but separately reported. Audit 5 viewed groups / fit 6 viewed groups independent summaries; no B/D until C sealed, no automatic deployment.
